final: WITH bucket_counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, bucket_count, CAST(bucket_count AS REAL) / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share FROM bucket_counts), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.bucket_count) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE s.share > a.average_share
